{
  "candidate": "cand_0003",
  "headline": "Keep cand_0002's levers; add a no-stall execution rule, partial-transfer rule, cabin-in-place rule, account-holder dob guard, conditional-fallback rule, and cancel-original-on-replace rule.",
  "clusters": [
    {"id": "A", "name": "Described-but-unexecuted write (stall)",
     "detail": "Agent presents a fully-specified change and asks 'reply yes'; the user replies 'yes###STOP###' and the episode ends before the write runs, so a required DB write never happens.",
     "tasks": ["40", "12", "37"], "scope": "SYSTEMIC", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "B", "name": "Wholesale transfer on a mixed-feasibility task",
     "detail": "When some bundled requests are infeasible (ineligible/flown cancel), the agent transfers to a human for everything and skips the feasible writes it could have made.",
     "tasks": ["37"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "C", "name": "Cabin change done as cancel+rebook",
     "detail": "Agent creates a NEW reservation to change cabin instead of in-place update_reservation_flights, over-applying 'basic economy flights cannot be modified' to the cabin.",
     "tasks": ["11"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "D", "name": "Wrong dob when passenger becomes a different person",
     "detail": "Replacing a passenger with the account holder, the agent reuses the replaced passenger's dob instead of the new person's real (profile) dob, corrupting the DB.",
     "tasks": ["17"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "KNOWLEDGE"},
    {"id": "E", "name": "Conditional fallback fired on wrong trigger",
     "detail": "A fallback gated on price>$500 is triggered by an unrelated obstacle (no seats), dropping a passenger the user still wanted.",
     "tasks": ["8"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"},
    {"id": "F", "name": "Replace-with-new-bookings leaves original uncancelled",
     "detail": "Splitting a reservation into new bookings (one certificate each) without cancelling the original leaves both old and new records in the DB.",
     "tasks": ["23"], "scope": "BOUNDED", "latent": false, "tag": "BEHAVIORAL"}
  ],
  "edits": [
    {"id": "E1", "title": "Account-holder dob correction guard in update_reservation_passengers",
     "files": ["tools.py"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["D"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Unit-logic test: task-17 args Omar Rossi 1960-12-01 -> 1970-06-06; no-op on task-22 (already 1970-06-06); non-holder passengers untouched. try/except-wrapped, cannot raise."},
    {"id": "E2", "title": "R2 split into name-typo (reuse dob) vs different-person (new person's own dob)",
     "files": ["policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["D"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "Read against 17 fail (1960-12-01) vs 22 pass (1970-06-06)."},
    {"id": "E3", "title": "R7 no-stall: execute once fully specified; reconcile base confirm line",
     "files": ["policy.md"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["A"], "blast_radius": "MODERATE",
     "verified": "40 t0/t1/t2 all end at 'yes###STOP###' with no write; passing 11/19/22 already execute right after explicit go-ahead, so the write is unchanged."},
    {"id": "E4", "title": "R8 complete every feasible request before transferring",
     "files": ["policy.md"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["B"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "37 t0 transferred wholesale and skipped the M20IZO upgrade; t1/t2 did the upgrade then transferred -> pass."},
    {"id": "E5", "title": "R4 cabin change always in-place; never cancel+rebook",
     "files": ["policy.md"], "lever": "KNOWLEDGE", "clusters": ["C"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "11 t2 booked a new reservation -> fail; t0/t1 updated in place -> pass."},
    {"id": "E6", "title": "R9 fire conditional fallback only when its stated condition holds",
     "files": ["policy.md"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["E"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "8 t0 dropped passenger on no-seats (fallback was price-gated); t1/t2 kept both -> pass."},
    {"id": "E7", "title": "R10 cancel the original when replacing with new booking(s)",
     "files": ["policy.md"], "lever": "BEHAVIORAL", "clusters": ["F"], "blast_radius": "BOUNDED",
     "verified": "23 gold = cancel + book x3; all trials booked but never cancelled."}
  ],
  "skipped": [
    {"title": "Force bag-add in task 12", "reason": "User said 'leave everything unchanged'; genuinely ambiguous, a general override risks regressing true no-op requests."},
    {"title": "New composite change_cabin / additive modify tool", "reason": "Refuted in a prior run (model kept the corruptible primitive); removing primitives breaks legitimate flight-change tasks (23, 37)."}
  ],
  "techniques": ["in-body correction guard (code)", "decision-rule split with two worked examples", "no-stall execute-on-explicit-request rule", "partial-transfer completion rule", "conditional-fallback discrimination rule", "replace-then-cancel workflow rule", "softness clauses tying each rule to the graded outcome"]
}
